item.title: Minakami White-Water Rafting: Japan's Premier Rafting Destination — Guide
item.description: Minakami has established itself as one of Japan’s premier white-water rafting destinations, its stretch of the upper Tone River offering consistent, reliable rapids fed by mountain snowmelt through spring and summer. Numerous outfitters run guided rafting tours suited to a range of experience levels, from gentle introductions for first-time paddlers to more technical routes through faster water, with the surrounding gorge scenery — dramatic in spring’s fresh greenery and autumn’s colour — adding to the appeal beyond the adrenaline of the rapids themselves.

item.title: Nagatoro Outdoor Activities: White Water Rafting & River Adventure — Guide
item.description: Beyond its traditional wooden boat rides, Nagatoro’s stretch of the Arakawa River offers a range of more adventurous water sports, including white water rafting through rocky rapids, canoeing and river trekking. Guided tours run by local operators cater to various experience levels, from families seeking a mild rafting introduction to more experienced paddlers wanting a faster, technical run through the gorge’s rockier sections. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Nagatoro, Saitama Hours Tours typically 9:00–16:00 (seasonal, weather-dependent) Admission Around ¥5,000–7,000 per rafting tour Time needed 2–3 hours Best time Spring–autumn; higher water levels in early summer What to Do White water rafting through the gorge’s rocky rapids.
